# Matt Pocock skills adaptations

The website's [diagnosing-bugs](../../.agents/skills/diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md), [writing-for-agents](../../.agents/skills/writing-for-agents/SKILL.md), and shared [behavioral testing reference](../../.agents/skills/diagnosing-bugs/references/behavioral-testing.md) adapt selected material from [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) at commit `dd400c3ad65e57c06f05e832e0aac92c7992f34d`.

Reviewed source files at that exact revision:

- [skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/dd400c3ad65e57c06f05e832e0aac92c7992f34d/skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md)
- [skills/productivity/writing-for-agents/SKILL.md](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/dd400c3ad65e57c06f05e832e0aac92c7992f34d/skills/productivity/writing-for-agents/SKILL.md)
- [skills/engineering/tdd/SKILL.md](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/dd400c3ad65e57c06f05e832e0aac92c7992f34d/skills/engineering/tdd/SKILL.md)
- [skills/engineering/tdd/tests.md](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/dd400c3ad65e57c06f05e832e0aac92c7992f34d/skills/engineering/tdd/tests.md)
- [skills/engineering/tdd/mocking.md](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/dd400c3ad65e57c06f05e832e0aac92c7992f34d/skills/engineering/tdd/mocking.md)
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/dd400c3ad65e57c06f05e832e0aac92c7992f34d/LICENSE)

The adaptations use proportionate reproduction and investigation, independently established behavior expectations, and conditional documentation pointers. They add website-specific artifact preservation, native/static/browser distinctions, and current-release evidence boundaries. They omit fixed hypothesis/stress quotas, Bash helpers, mandatory test-boundary confirmation, and dependencies on uninstalled upstream workflows. They introduce no global installation or automatic update process.
